title: What Post-Money Market Designs Is
definition: Post-Money Market Designs: markets coordinating without money.
description:
Strip Post-Money Market Designs to its essence and you get markets coordinating without money. Simple to say, civilizational to build.

The path runs through Post-Scarcity Economy: first allocation algorithms understanding, then market logistics prototypes, then preference signals operations at scale. Each stage has its own physics, its own economics, and its own failure modes — this database maps all three.

Use the ladder: start with foundations, work through the components and forecasts, run every demo, then attempt the compounded drills. By the final record you will hold a working mental model of market hulls, grounded in real research and honest about what remains unknown.

t: Real Research Today: Post-Money Market Designs
title: Real Research Today: Post-Money Market Designs
definition: Today's documented research behind Post-Money Market Designs.
description:
The road to Post-Money Market Designs is already being paved. Time-banking networks (TimeBanks USA) trade hours as currency in hundreds of communities. Open-source hardware (Arduino, RISC-V) shows zero-marginal-cost production at scale.

The Maricá (Brazil) basic income and Spain's ingreso mínimo vital are large public pilots. Together these programs form the allocation algorithms foundation that Post-Money Market Designs will build on — the market logistics results, the preference signals methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as market logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: 2030 — First city-scale market hulls pilots launch: allocation algorith
definition: 2030 milestone on the Post-Money Market Designs roadmap.
description:
First city-scale market hulls pilots launch: allocation algorithms issuance and market logistics exchange running live.

What must be true first: the allocation algorithms results have to replicate outside the lab, market logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and preference signals operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed allocation algorithms demonstrations, market logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting preference signals uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Post-Money Market Designs
definition: Estimates Post-Money Market Designs readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Post-Money Market Designs components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a market hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Post-Money Market Designs Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Post-Money Market Designs operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Post-Money Market Designs installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 83125 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where allocation algorithms monitoring, market logistics redundancy, or preference signals maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Post-Money Market Designs Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Post-Money Market Designs: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Post-Money Market Designs — markets coordinating without money.

Phase 1 — Prove (allocation algorithms): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (market logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (preference signals): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (fairness proofs): market hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and theory-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
